summary:
Implementation plan for mobile optimization and automatic screen orientation rotation for Tactical Realms: 3D Chess:
1. Screen Orientation & Fullscreen Manager: Automatically attempt landscape lock using screen.orientation.lock('landscape') on launch and on user gesture; render an animated rotating-phone overlay when in portrait mode.
2. Small-Screen Layout Adaptations: Add swipeable carousel snapping for realm cards and feature pillars on small screens (<480px), comfortable touch-target sizing (min 44px), and compact headers.
3. In-Game Mobile HUD & Viewport: Optimize 3D camera FOV and board framing for small mobile landscape viewports, compact top status bar, and smooth pause/exit sheet.
